text: On the Tel Aviv demo cycle route, several fixed lane delineators have snapped off at ground level.
The cobblestones in the shared street have shifted into an uneven ridge that catches bicycle tyres.
A tread is missing from the municipal pedestrian steps, leaving a gap in the staircase.
Windblown leaflets now blanket the paved public courtyard; please arrange a sweep.
A large heap of cut branches and garden trimmings was left on the promenade for removal.
A refuse truck spilled mixed rubbish at the junction, leaving a trail across the carriageway.
Half the LED panels on the high-mast public light have stopped working while the remaining panels still glow.
The maintenance hatch on the streetlight column is jammed open; the internal wiring remains behind its intact sealed barrier.
A thick white salt coating has formed on the seaside lamp housing and its glass needs specialist cleaning.
There is a new pothole beside an overflowing rubbish bin, and both need attention.
